description:
In response to the negative reception of VULTURES 2, Ye decided to begin work on a new solo album that was much simpler and stripped back than the VULTURES era sound, being built around sample chops. On September 28th, 2024, on the second Haikou listening event, Ye confirmed that the album's name is BULLY, which references the movie with the same name that he posted on his Instagram story a few days prior to the event. On January 2nd, 2025, Ye announced the album would have AI on it after months of speculation, and that it could help AI become used more in music. This concept was scrapped for release, with Ye resinging the AI last minute in response to fan backlash.

(08/23/2024) (Ye starts working on a new album after the Korea VULTURES LP)
(03/18/2025) (Ye posts BULLY V1 to his Twitter and denounces AI)
